BUILT TO LAST
                                                 The MWE Gold V3 brings a new standard of durability and efficiency to
                                                 Cooler Master’s lineup of power supply units. This 80 Plus Gold certified unit
                                                 can achieve Titanium level efficiency at light loads in a 115V test.

                                                 With an APFC half bridge LLC and DC-to-DC design, the MWE Gold V3 has
                                                 achieved an 80 Plus Gold efficiency certification with top-tier performance.
                                                 A smart thermal control mode and a zero-RPM default mode reduces noise
                                                 and improves heat dissipation. Combined with an ATX 3.1 12V-2x6 native
                                                 cable featuring a space-saving, durable 90-degree connector, the MWE
                                                 Gold V3 is a powerhouse.
